title: Cold rebuild: the greeting tests
summary: Make the time-of-day tests deterministic again, from an empty editor.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *Why tests flake* you replaced a clock-reading test with fixed moments and a time zone. Write those tests again from an **empty editor**.

steps.title: The greeting tests, cold
prompt: `Greeting.For(TimeProvider clock)` says "Good morning" before 12:00, "Good afternoon" before 18:00, else "Good evening", in the clock's **local** time.
Write `public class GreetingTests` with at least 5 tests on a `FakeTimeProvider` (both sides of each boundary) and one with a non-UTC local time zone. No real clock.
